components.name: Empty Smartphone
components.description: An upright smartphone with rounded corners, a blank screen, and a lower strip with a short home mark. Exclude all dollar signs, speech bubbles, location pins, and stethoscope tubing.

components.name: Empty Message Bubble
components.description: A rounded rectangular speech bubble with a pointed tail descending toward the lower left. Exclude the phone and location pin.

components.name: Teardrop Location Pin
components.description: A simple upright location pin with a rounded top narrowing into a sharp lower tip. Exclude the phone and speech bubble.
